title: Coupling chromosome organization to genome segregation in Archaea
authors: Kabli AF; Ng IW; Read N; Pal P; Reimann J; Tran NT; Albers S; Le TBK; Barillà D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究古菌SegAB蛋白介导的染色体组织与基因组分离机制，涉及蛋白-DNA多位点结合与DNA压缩/成环，但无AI或物理模拟方法，且非典型TF-DNA体系，仅对蛋白-DNA互作机制有参考价值。
abstract: Chromosome segregation is a fundamental process in all life forms and requires coordination with genome organization, replication and cell division. The mechanism that mediates chromosome segregation in archaea remains enigmatic, despite the centre-stage role assumed by these organisms in the discourse about the origin of eukaryotes. Previously, we identified two proteins, SegA and SegB, which form a minimalist chromosome partition machine in Sulfolobales. Here we uncover patterns and mechanisms that the SegAB system employs to link chromosome organization to genome segregation. Deletion of the genes causes growth and chromosome partition defects. SegB binds to multiple sites scattered across the chromosome, but mainly localised close to the segAB locus in most archaeal genera. The sites are predominantly intragenic and enriched in one of the two compartments into which the chromosome folds. We show that SegB coalesces into multiple foci through the nucleoid, exhibiting a biased localisation towards the cell periphery, which hints at potential tethers to the cell membrane. The short-range DNA compaction activity of SegB and long-range looping of distant sites point to a significant role for SegB in chromosome condensation that in turn enables genome segregation. Collectively, our data put forward SegAB as important players in bridging chromosome organization to genome segregation in archaea.
abstract_zh: 染色体分离是所有生命形式中的一个基本过程，需要与基因组组织、复制和细胞分裂协调进行。尽管古菌在关于真核生物起源的讨论中占据核心地位，但介导古菌染色体分离的机制仍然是个谜。此前，我们鉴定了两种蛋白质SegA和SegB，它们在硫叶菌目（Sulfolobales）中形成一套极简的染色体分配机器。在此，我们揭示了SegAB系统用于将染色体组织与基因组分离相连接的图案和机制。基因缺失会导致生长和染色体分配缺陷。SegB结合散布在染色体上的多个位点，但在大多数古菌属中主要定位于segAB基因座附近。这些位点主要位于基因内部，并富集于染色体折叠成的两个区室之一。我们显示SegB通过拟核凝聚成多个焦点，表现出偏向细胞周边的定位，这暗示其可能与细胞膜存在潜在的锚定连接。SegB的短程DNA压缩活性和远距离位点的长程环化表明SegB在染色体凝缩中发挥重要作用，进而实现基因组分离。总体而言，我们的数据提出SegAB是连接古菌染色体组织与基因组分离的重要参与者。
